observationalScope: Documentation/code review only; the reviewer did not execute or independently replicate the runtime probe.
materialFindings: The ArkTS loaded log records a non-throwing synchronous call rather than an independently observed library lifecycle event.
The ArkTS probe records a caller-written destroyed log and zero matching pixels without independently observing the library destroy callback.
ArkTS captures lack frame indexes and timestamps.
The observation covers an unsigned ARM emulator only.
No real-device signed Release/AOT result, 100-cycle leak/stress audit or complex-animation matrix was supplied.
Drop-in replacement, SVG/HTML renderer support and production readiness are excluded.
amendedMaterialFindings: Target vs runtime conflation: packed metadata declares minimum/target API 20 (60000020), while actual amended execution ran on HarmonyOS 7.0.0 / API 26 (arm64-v8a Mate 90 Pro emulator).
The revised DOMLoaded/destroy/enterFrame lifecycle probe never executed on an API 20 runtime; the 2026-11-09 API 20 run used caller-log-level events with different log names.
Frame/timestamp attribution has clock/capture offsets (+8.893 s for pinned-0, -0.661 s inverted for pinned-18, +0.506 s for destroyed) and post-hoc selection of the second pinned-0 observation.
enterFrame count (10) is an instrumentation cap rather than total frame coverage; Web fixture HTML/script hashes changed between 2026-11-09 and 2026-11-11, and browser binary lacks a file hash.
JSON animation field v="5.12.2" identifies the Bodymovin exporter schema rather than independently verifying lottie-web runtime version.
No physical device, release signing, AOT/bytecode profiling, 100/1000-cycle stress/leak test, aboutToDisappear/background lifecycle coverage, or complex animation matrix exists.

amendedCandidateWording.short: On one authored synthetic vector fixture, lottie-web 5.12.2 (Web Canvas) and @ohos/lottie 2.0.0 (ArkTS / ArkUI Canvas) each completed load (DOMLoaded), playback, looping, and single explicit destroy() pixel clear; the ArkTS artifact declares API 20 target but ran on a HarmonyOS 7.0.0 / API 26 emulator (arm64-v8a, unsigned debug), not an API 20 runtime replication.
activationConditions: Re-run the 2026-11-11 Index.ets lifecycle instrumentation on an actual HarmonyOS 6.0.0 / API 20 runtime.
Complete runtime matrix coverage across API 20 and API 26 with explicit release, apiLevel, imageVersion, and ABI accounting (arm vs arm64-v8a).
Verify on at least one physical device with release signing, release build mode, and separate AOT/profiling measurements.
Run repeated load/destroy (100+ cycles), double-destroy, listener cleanup, background/foreground, and aboutToDisappear() leak/stress checks.
Unify host/device clock attribution for pinned frames and captures.
Cover complex animation features (image assets, text, masks, mattes, gradients, expressions, layer effects).
Pin and hash the Web browser binary, independently verify upstream package hashes, and document the 11-09 vs 11-11 Web fixture diff.
Complete non-author independent review and governance approval before setting knowledgeMappingImported or independentAcceptanceVerified to true.
Enforce phrasing gate requiring single-fixture, emulator, unsigned-debug, API-20-target/API-26-runtime, and non-drop-in/non-pixel-parity qualifiers.

amendedReviewFailureSummary: Attempts 1 and 2 stopped before a model response with connection_failed/ECONNREFUSED; attempt 3 succeeded on 2026-11-12 using the identical public-only bundle and returned support-only-with-amendments.
